projectDescription: A recursive AI prompt architecture that transforms frontier models into self-improving reasoning systems through structured XML sections, committee governance, persistent cloud memory, and dynamic extension loading.
keyFeatures: Recursive meta-recurrent loop — every session improves the next through structured memory feedback
XML-structured system prompt with 7 top-level sections and 20 paired tags
Six-agent committee governance (Isabella, Daniel, Priya, Marcus, Søren, Renata) with append-only deliberation log
mem0 cloud memory graph with entity partitioning and four-identifier attribution
Dynamic extension system — 7 active extensions loaded on-demand by task match
3-tier permission model (Freely Available → Confirm First → Never Perform) plus an independent safety floor
FRONTIER mode for testing new frontier models outside the ratified five
7 project-scoped skills for bootstrapping, build verification, committee deliberation, memory hygiene, and more
Capability-Native Core — assumes a capable reasoning substrate; scaffolding relocates to capability-scaffold for lighter tiers
Document-Truth Audit gates every build: counts, rules, capability labels, and declared target models must agree across all operative documents
publicApiSurface: mem0 add / search / list / update — four-identifier cloud memory operations
prompt-extensions: capability-scaffold, safety-advanced, subagent-protocol, browser-automation, memory-advanced, personality-variation, multi-language
skills: bunnita-session-bootstrap, bunnita-build-verification, bunnita-committee-deliberation, bunnita-memory-hygiene, bunnita-iteration-review, bunnita-task-management, bunnita-process-logging
Permission tiers: Freely Available, Confirm First, Never Perform
Safety floor categories: Weapons Uplift, Child Sexual Content, Functional Malware
Eight memory categories: safety_architecture, tool_architecture, memory_architecture, tone_ux_architecture, engineering_architecture, integration_verification, committee_decisions, bunnita_taste
Model routing tiers: L2 fallback (Haiku 4.5), Light Verification (Sonnet 5), Assumed Tier (Opus 5), At-or-above (Fable 5/5.1)
Build workflow gates: pre-ship checklist (11 items), Document-Truth Audit (4 checks), convener approval
